summary:
When this is built, a named corporate client (per company) can have an on-account record. It holds the client's legal name, NTN/STRN, contact, credit limit, payment terms (default 30 days), an overdue grace period (default 7 days), an optional "reference required" switch and optional allowed brands. Finance creates and edits clients under Finance > Books > Receivables > On-account clients. A new client and every credit-limit increase wait for the CEO in the approvals inbox (provider on_account_client). Decreases and suspensions apply at once.

Each client gets one or more named QR cards. The QR holds an opaque random code (format SVOA-XXXXX-XXXXX-XXXXX-XXXXX, about 100 bits). It is never the client id and never a URL. Only its sha256 hash and the last 4 characters are stored. The code is shown once, when the card is issued or rotated, and printed from the client page then. Reprinting means rotating, which kills the old card. Revoking blocks a card, and a revoked card scanned at a till raises an exception.

At the admin POS the cashier picks "On account" and scans the card. Scanning works three ways: a USB or Bluetooth keyboard-wedge scanner, the camera through BarcodeDetector where the browser has it, or typing the code. The server checks the card against the ORDER's company only. It then checks, under the order lock and then a row lock on the client: the client is active; the brand is allowed; no statement is unpaid past its due date plus grace; and open exposure plus this bill stays within the limit. Open exposure is unbilled charges + open statements + linked invoices. No manager PIN is needed.

The whole bill is re-priced at the CASH tax class (lib/pricing tenderOf('on_account') = 'cash'). It is settled by one Payment(method on_account, status paid) on the cashier's drawer plus one CustomerAccountCharge row. It then completes through the existing applyCoverageTx, afterTillSale and completeOrder path. That gives exactly one fiscal sale document at supply (H14). The document has tender 'on_account' and the client as buyer (name/NTN/STRN), and the auto-issued tax invoice names the client. The bill prints "Charged to <client> (OA-0003)" with a signature line.

Ledger:
- A till sale's shift close debits 1110 per client, memo prefix ON ACCOUNT. A non-till dine-in bill's order.complete does the same. Revenue, tax and the rest are booked as today.
- A refund of an on-account bill goes back to the account through the ONE refund engine: Cr 1110, the fiscal return in the same transaction, and the charge's refunded amount, plus its statement's credited amount if it was already billed.
- 1110 becomes the invoiced-customer ledger only. All till clearing (unsettled bills, refund due on cancelled tickets, card failed after close, Raast "customer owes" write-offs) moves to a new 1115 Till Clearing. A self-healing sweep journal moves the legacy till-clearing balance out of 1110 at boot and daily.

Monthly, finance issues statements: one per client (or bulk for every client) for the calendar month. A statement is a ReceivableInvoice of kind 'statement' (AR-ST-YYYY-NNNN) over the unbilled charges. It has NO new ledger entry (the revenue and 1110 were booked at the till) and is never a second tax invoice. Its HTML lists every bill with its fiscal number and can be printed or emailed. Payments, income-tax withholding, refunds and bounced-cheque reversals use the existing receivables routes against the statement. Credit notes on a statement are refused, so an adjustment goes through the till refund and its fiscal return. Overdue statements raise flags, and finance can send a reminder email.

Bad debts: finance requests a write-off on any invoice or statement. The request carries an amount (up to the balance), a reason and 1-5 evidence files (JPEG/PNG/WebP/PDF, 3 MB or less, stored as bytes). The CEO approves or rejects it in the approvals inbox (provider bad_debt), and the approver can never be the requester. Approval posts 'receivable.write_off:<id>' in the invoice's company: Dr 6160 (split per brand for statements) / Cr 1110 for the full amount including tax. It adds the amount to writtenOffCents on the invoice and suspends the client. A later recovery puts the amount back (Dr 1110 / Cr 6160) and records the payment in the same transaction.

Raast "void, never booked" (RV-MONEY-1): finance may request it, and only the CEO voids. It applies to a provisional receipt on a cancelled or rejected order where every drawer it touched is closed with nothing failed, and nothing ever debited the bank for it. The receipt becomes status 'voided' with the reason, actor and time, and the void is audited in the receipt's company. There is NO ledger posting. The bank reference stays claimed, so the same transfer can never pay another bill. The receipt stops blocking period close. The approvals inbox lists void requests (provider raast_void).

No new module id is needed. Client admin sits under /accounting (module 'accounting'), the till routes under ungated /pos, and the Raast void under /reconciliation ('reconciliation').

schema.prisma Receivables comment 'Till sales settle immediately and never come here'. It is replaced by 'on-account till sales reach 1110 through the shift close and are billed on monthly statements'

Till clearing on 1110. shiftPosting.ts lines 471/474/506 (unsettled / settled elsewhere / REFUND DUE), postPosCardFailure line 787, orderPosting.ts line 771 (refund-due hand-back) and pos/service.ts 3191/3213 (cancelled-ticket parking) are replaced by ACCT.TILL_CLEARING '1115'. Legacy lines stay where they are, and lookups read both codes (TILL_CLEARING_CODES)

schema_delta:
MIGRATION A (own file, must sort first; it can be merged with the other Wave B enum values; a new enum value can't be used in the transaction that adds it — precedent 20261013090000_raast_enum_values):
  ALTER TYPE "PaymentMethod" ADD VALUE IF NOT EXISTS 'on_account';
  ALTER TYPE "RaastReceiptStatus" ADD VALUE IF NOT EXISTS 'voided';

Prisma:
enum PaymentMethod { …existing…, on_account // a named on-account client's bill (owner 2026-10-13): Dr 1110 at the close, billed on a monthly statement; cash tax class; own route POST /pos/orders/:id/on-account, never POST /pos/payments }
enum RaastReceiptStatus { …existing…, voided // the CEO voided a provisional receipt whose sale was never booked (RV-MONEY-1); no ledger }

// On-account clients (owner 2026-10-13). Per company. creditLimit is company-level money → BIGINT (BOOKS-06).
model CustomerAccount {
  id String @id @default(uuid())
  tenantId String
  number String                     // OA-0001 per company (advisory lock)
  legalName String
  tradeName String?
  ntn String?
  strn String?
  cnic String?
  address String?
  contactName String?
  contactPhone String?
  contactEmail String?
  creditLimitCents BigInt @default(0)
  requestedCreditLimitCents BigInt? // an increase waiting for the CEO
  limitRequestedById String?
  limitRequestedAt DateTime?
  termsDays Int @default(30)
  overdueGraceDays Int @default(7)
  requiresReference Boolean @default(false)
  conceptIds String[] @default([])  // empty = every brand of the company
  status String @default("pending") // pending | active | suspended | closed
  statusReason String?
  approvedById String?
  approvedAt DateTime?
  createdById String
  notes String?
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt
  cards CustomerAccountCard[]
  charges CustomerAccountCharge[]
  @@unique([tenantId, number])
  @@unique([tenantId, legalName])
  @@index([tenantId, status])
  @@map("customer_accounts")
}
model CustomerAccountCard {
  id String @id @default(uuid())
  tenantId String
  accountId String
  label String                      // "Reception", "Mr Khan"
  tokenHash String                  // sha256 hex of the normalised code; the code is never stored
  tokenHint String                  // last 4 chars
  issuedById String
  issuedAt DateTime @default(now())
  revokedAt DateTime?
  revokedById String?
  revokedReason String?             // rotated | lost | <text>
  lastUsedAt DateTime?
  account CustomerAccount @relation(fields: [accountId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  @@unique([tenantId, tokenHash])
  @@index([tenantId, accountId])
  @@map("customer_account_cards")
}
// One row per on-account bill. Per-ticket money stays INT4 like Payment.
model CustomerAccountCharge {
  id String @id @default(uuid())
  tenantId String
  accountId String
  cardId String?
  orderId String
  paymentId String
  conceptId String
  shiftId String?
  amountCents Int
  taxCents Int @default(0)
  refundedCents Int @default(0)
  reference String?                 // client PO / who signed
  chargedById String
  chargedAt DateTime @default(now())
  statementInvoiceId String?        // ReceivableInvoice kind 'statement'
  account CustomerAccount @relation(fields: [accountId], references: [id])
  @@unique([tenantId, orderId])
  @@unique([tenantId, paymentId])
  @@index([tenantId, accountId, statementInvoiceId])
  @@index([statementInvoiceId])
  @@map("customer_account_charges")
}
// Bad-debt write-offs (owner: the CEO approves every one). BIGINT money.
model ReceivableWriteOff {
  id String @id @default(uuid())
  tenantId String
  invoiceId String
  amountCents BigInt
  reason String
  status String @default("requested") // requested | approved | rejected | cancelled
  requestedById String
  requestedAt DateTime @default(now())
  decidedById String?
  decidedAt DateTime?
  decisionNote String?
  journalEntryId String?
  recoveredCents BigInt @default(0)
  attachments ReceivableWriteOffAttachment[]
  @@index([tenantId, status])
  @@index([invoiceId])
  @@map("receivable_write_offs")
}
model ReceivableWriteOffAttachment {
  id String @id @default(uuid())
  tenantId String
  writeOffId String
  fileName String
  mime String                       // image/jpeg|png|webp | application/pdf
  sizeBytes Int
  data Bytes
  uploadedById String
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
  writeOff ReceivableWriteOff @relation(fields: [writeOffId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  @@index([writeOffId])
  @@map("receivable_write_off_attachments")
}
model ReceivableInvoice { +customerAccountId String?  +periodFrom DateTime?  +periodTo DateTime?  +writtenOffCents BigInt @default(0)  // kind: invoice | credit_note | statement; status adds written_off
  +@@index([tenantId, customerAccountId, status]) }
model ReceivablePayment { +writeOffId String? // a recovery of a written-off amount }
model RaastReceipt { +voidRequestedAt DateTime? +voidRequestedById String? +voidRequestReason String? +voidedAt DateTime? +voidedById String? +voidReason String? }

SQL-only (main migration, SET lock_timeout='15s', additive only):
- CREATE UNIQUE INDEX receivable_write_offs_one_open ON receivable_write_offs ("invoiceId") WHERE status = 'requested';  (Prisma can't express it — do not re-declare in schema)
- CHECKs: customer_accounts ("creditLimitCents" >= 0 AND "termsDays" BETWEEN 1 AND 180 AND "overdueGraceDays" BETWEEN 0 AND 90); customer_account_charges ("amountCents" > 0 AND "refundedCents" >= 0 AND "refundedCents" <= "amountCents"); receivable_invoices ("writtenOffCents" >= 0); receivable_write_offs ("amountCents" > 0 AND "recoveredCents" >= 0 AND "recoveredCents" <= "amountCents").
- RLS block (same DO $do$ pattern as 20261013150000_finance_gaps_wave_a) on customer_accounts, customer_account_cards, customer_account_charges, receivable_write_offs, receivable_write_off_attachments: USING/WITH CHECK (app_is_service_mode() OR "tenantId" = ANY(app_tenant_ids())).
- No raw FKs to orders/payments (would be schema drift); no backfill of rows.
chart_accounts: 1115 Till Clearing — asset — REQUIRED (add to REQUIRED_ACCOUNT_CODES). It holds till bills not settled on their drawer, money owed back on cancelled tickets, card tenders failed after the close and Raast 'customer owes' write-offs. It never holds invoiced customer balances

6160 Bad Debts Written Off — expense — not required (a missing code refuses the write-off with ACCOUNT_NOT_FOUND and nothing is saved). A direct write-off of a customer balance the CEO approved, with reason and evidence on file (H15 default 'direct', no general provision)
1110 Customer Accounts Receivable — existing — now REQUIRED. It now holds ONLY ReceivableInvoice balances (invoices, statements) and booked on-account charges not yet billed
Not added: 1335 (sales tax withheld by customers, H13) belongs to the tax area. Statements use whatever withholding route that area adds
postings: On-account TILL sale (source 'pos', also a group bill whose door is 'payment'): 'shift.close:<shiftId>' — company is shiftTenantId(shift), the order's drawer company. Existing idempotency per shift and existing period-lock check. Added lines: Dr 1110 per client, memo '<ON_ACCOUNT_MEMO> — OA-0003 Acme Ltd — #REF1, #REF2 (shift xxxxxxxx)', from summariseShiftSales.onAccount.byAccount (read from Payment.gatewayMeta.onAccount {accountId, number, name}). The sale side (revenue 4xxx, 4100, 2095, output tax by outputTaxCodeFor, 7010, COGS) is unchanged. gap = 0, so no unsettled line

On-account NON-TILL bill settled at the till (dine-in, door 'payment'): 'order.complete:<orderId>' — company is concept.tenantId. buildSaleLines adds Dr 1110 for paid on_account rows (capped at what is left after cash/Raast, memo prefixed ON_ACCOUNT_MEMO). Idempotent per order. A refusal flags posting_failed through the existing postCompletionOrFlag

Refund of an on-account bill (one refund engine, inside refundOrder's order-locked tx): 'order.refund:<refundPaymentId>' — company is concept.tenantId. Dr revenue/4100/2095/output-tax shares (refundDebitLines) / Cr 1110 (refundCreditAccount('on_account') → ACCT.CUSTOMER_AR, memo prefixed ON_ACCOUNT_MEMO). Same tx: enqueueFiscalRefundTx (method on_account) and applyChargeRefundTx, which adds to charge.refundedCents and, if the charge is billed, to the statement's creditedCents and re-statuses it. A refused posting rolls the whole refund back (REFUND_NOT_POSTED 422)
Statement issue: NO posting. The revenue, tax and 1110 debit were booked at the till. It is not a tax invoice (H14 'supply')

Statement payment / withholding / refund / reversal: the existing 'receivable.payment' (Dr moneyAccountCode / Cr 1110), 'receivable.wht' (Dr 1330 / Cr 1110), 'receivable.refund', and '<x>.reversal' via reverseJournalEntry, all in the invoice's company and inside the invoice-locked tx. Unchanged

Bad-debt write-off approval: 'receivable.write_off:<writeOffId>' — company is invoice.tenantId, entryDate = approval time, inside the approve tx (lock order: client account, then invoice). Dr 6160 / Cr 1110 for amountCents (the full amount including tax; no sales-tax bad-debt relief). For a statement, the 6160 debit is split per conceptId pro rata to its charges' net, and Cr 1110 is one line. For an invoice, the conceptId is the invoice's. Idempotent per write-off id. A closed period gives 422 and nothing is saved

Write-off recovery: 'receivable.write_off_recovery:<paymentId>' Dr 1110 / Cr 6160 plus 'receivable.payment:<paymentId>' Dr moneyAccountCode(method, bankAccountId of the invoice's company) / Cr 1110, both in ONE tx with ReceivableWriteOff.recoveredCents increment and invoice writtenOffCents decrement and paidCents increment. A bounced recovery cheque reverses only the payment entry, so the invoice owes it again

Till-clearing sweep (one-time + self-healing): 'ledger.till_clearing_split:<tenantId>:<n>' (n = count of prior split entries + 1, under pg_advisory_xact_lock per tenant). X = net Dr−Cr of the tenant's 1110 lines whose entry reference does NOT start with 'receivable.' and whose memo does NOT start with ON_ACCOUNT_MEMO. If X ≠ 0 it posts Cr 1110 / Dr 1115 for X (reversed sign if X<0), dated now. It runs at boot after ensureChartOfAccounts and daily. A refusal goes to flagPostingFailed (sourceType 'ledger.till_clearing_split', entity Tenant), and the REPOSTERS entry re-runs it. A re-run with X = 0 posts nothing

Till clearing (code swap only): shift close unsettled Dr / settled-elsewhere Cr / REFUND DUE Cr, refund-due hand-back Dr (orderPosting 771), cancelled-ticket parking (pos/service 3191/3213), 'pos.card_failed' Dr all use 1115 instead of 1110. The lookups of legacy REFUND DUE lines (saleBookingOf, pos/service cancelledTicketBooksTx 3092, raast saleBookedTx) match code IN TILL_CLEARING_CODES ['1115','1110']
Raast write-off 'raast.unreceived:<receiptId>' (existing): the default/allowed contra 'customer owes' becomes 1115. Contras are ['1115','8010','1350']
Raast void (CEO): NO posting by design. Nothing ever debited the bank for the receipt. Finance books the statement credit with the bank line's own adjustment, as resolveAttentionReceipt already does
routes: POST /pos/on-account/lookup — CASHIERS, ungated (/pos), rateLimit 20/min. Body {orderId uuid, code string ≤ 40}. The order comes from scopeTenantWhere(req,'write') (foreign → 404). The card is looked up by hashCardCode(normalizeCardCode(code)) WITHIN order.concept.tenantId only. Returns {account:{id, number, legalName, limitCents, exposureCents, availableCents, requiresReference}, card:{id, label, hint}, quote:{dueCents, taxRatePct}, blocked: null | {code, message}}. Errors: ON_ACCOUNT_CARD_UNKNOWN 404 (unknown or other company; never confirms existence); ON_ACCOUNT_CARD_REVOKED 409 plus exception flag on_account_card_revoked_used
GET /pos/orders/:orderId/on-account/quote — CASHIERS. quoteOrderForTender(orderId, 'on_account'), the cash class. Foreign order → 404

POST /pos/orders/:orderId/on-account — CASHIERS, NO manager PIN. Body {shiftId uuid, code, reference? ≤ 80, idempotencyKey 8..100}. Guards: order in write scope (else 404); assertShiftOf(order tenant, shiftId, open) and assertDrawerOperator. chargeOrderToAccount runs one tx: lockOrderTx → idempotent replay → assertNoActiveTerminalChargeTx → assertTakesMoney → not completed → completionDoor(order)==='payment' (else 409 ON_ACCOUNT_NOT_HERE) → nothing paid yet and no tip (409 ON_ACCOUNT_WHOLE_BILL) → repriceForTenderTx(['on_account']) → lockAccountTx → assertChargeableTx (409 ON_ACCOUNT_NOT_ACTIVE / ON_ACCOUNT_BRAND_NOT_ALLOWED / ON_ACCOUNT_OVERDUE {statementNumber, dueDate, balanceCents} / ON_ACCOUNT_OVER_LIMIT {limitCents, exposureCents, availableCents, billCents}; 422 ON_ACCOUNT_REFERENCE_REQUIRED) → Payment(on_account, paid, shiftId, gatewayRef=number, gatewayMeta {idempotencyKey, onAccount:{accountId, cardId, number, name, reference}}) → recordChargeTx → applyCoverageTx('till'). Then afterTillSale → completeOrder. Returns {payment, charge, orderCompleted, fiscal, srb}. Audit 'order.on_account_charge' in the order's company

GET /accounting/customer-accounts — FINANCIALS_VIEWERS, module 'accounting', scopeTenantWhere 'read'. Query status?, overdue?=1, pending?=1 (pending clients or requested limit), q?. Rows carry exposure/available/overdue/unbilled/cardsActive

POST /accounting/customer-accounts — CLIENT_EDITORS ['admin','owner','management','finance']. Binds to the ACTIVE company ('create'); each conceptId goes through assertConceptOwned 'create' (foreign → 422). Body {legalName, tradeName?, ntn?, strn?, cnic?, address?, contactName?, contactPhone?, contactEmail?, creditLimitCents zMoneyCents positive, termsDays 1..180=30, overdueGraceDays 0..90=7, requiresReference=false, conceptIds=[], notes?}. status 'pending' (active + approvedBy when the actor is admin). 409 CLIENT_NAME_TAKEN. Audit in the account's company

GET /accounting/customer-accounts/:id — FINANCIALS_VIEWERS, 'read' scope, 404 foreign. Returns the account, cards (hint only), unbilled charges, statements and linked invoices with balances, write-offs and exposure

PATCH /accounting/customer-accounts/:id — CLIENT_EDITORS, 'write' scope (404 foreign). Edits details. A creditLimitCents increase → requestedCreditLimitCents (applied directly when the actor is admin); a decrease applies at once. status: 'suspended' (any editor, reason) | 'active' from suspended (admin only, 403 otherwise) | 'closed' (only with exposure 0, else 409 CLIENT_HAS_BALANCE)
POST /accounting/customer-accounts/:id/approve — ADMIN_ONLY. Activates a pending client and/or applies the requested limit. 409 NOTHING_PENDING
POST /accounting/customer-accounts/:id/reject — ADMIN_ONLY {note required}. A pending client → closed, or the requested limit is cleared
POST /accounting/customer-accounts/:id/cards — CLIENT_EDITORS {label}. Client not closed. Returns {card, code} — the code is shown ONCE and only the hash is stored
POST /accounting/customer-accounts/:id/cards/:cardId/rotate — CLIENT_EDITORS. The old card is revoked 'rotated' and a new code is returned once. Card of another account/company → 404
POST /accounting/customer-accounts/:id/cards/:cardId/revoke — CLIENT_EDITORS {reason}
GET /accounting/customer-accounts/:id/charges?from&to&unbilled — FINANCIALS_VIEWERS, read scope

POST /accounting/customer-accounts/:id/statements — CLIENT_EDITORS, write scope. Body {periodTo: YYYY-MM-DD, issueDate?}. Under lockAccountTx it claims the unbilled charges with chargedAt ≤ periodTo end of PKT day (updateMany where statementInvoiceId null) and creates ReceivableInvoice kind 'statement' (AR-ST-YYYY-NNNN, withNumberRetry, dueDate = issue + termsDays, amount/tax from charges net of refunds, customerAccountId, periodFrom/To). 409 NOTHING_TO_BILL
POST /accounting/customer-accounts/statements/issue — CLIENT_EDITORS, ACTIVE company only. Body {periodTo, accountIds?}. One statement per client with unbilled charges; returns created and skipped

GET /accounting/customer-accounts/statements/:invoiceId/html — FINANCIALS_VIEWERS, read scope. The printable statement: bills with date, order ref, brand, card, reference and FiscalDocument.fiscalNumber, plus previous balance, total due, due date, the company bank details, and 'Statement — not a tax invoice'
POST /accounting/customer-accounts/statements/:invoiceId/send — CLIENT_EDITORS. Emails the HTML to contactEmail (sendEmail; 422 NO_EMAIL); audited
POST /accounting/customer-accounts/:id/remind — CLIENT_EDITORS. Sends an overdue reminder email; at most 1 per client per day (409 REMINDED_TODAY)

GET /accounting/customer-accounts/tie-out — FINANCIALS_VIEWERS, read scope. Per company: 1110 GL balance vs open invoices + open statements + unbilled booked charges; the difference, plus unbilled not-yet-booked shown apart
POST /accounting/receivables — existing route, adds an optional customerAccountId (write scope, same company as the active company, else 422 CLIENT_NOT_IN_COMPANY) and copies the client's name/NTN
POST /accounting/receivables/:id/credit-notes — existing; a 'statement' → 409 STATEMENT_CREDIT_AT_TILL (refund the bill at the till so the fiscal return files)
POST /accounting/receivables/:id/void — existing; a statement voids only with nothing received/withheld/credited/written off. It releases its charges (statementInvoiceId=null) with no reversal entry

POST /accounting/receivables/:id/write-offs — WRITE_OFF_REQUESTERS ['admin','owner','management','finance'], write scope (404 foreign). Body {amountCents zMoneyCents positive ≤ balanceOf, reason 10..500, evidence:[{fileName, mime, data base64}] 1..5, each ≤ 3 MB through decodeEvidenceFile}. data_migration:
The migration is additive. Migration A adds the two enum values on their own: PaymentMethod 'on_account' and RaastReceiptStatus 'voided'. ADD VALUE IF NOT EXISTS is re-runnable. The main migration does the rest:
- five new tables with RLS, plus CHECKs and the partial unique;
- new nullable columns or BIGINT columns with default 0 on receivable_invoices, receivable_payments and raast_receipts.

No existing row is rewritten:
- old invoices get writtenOffCents 0 and kind 'invoice';
- old Raast receipts keep their status;
- there are no clients, cards or charges yet.

Chart: ensureChartOfAccounts (boot, every company) adds 1115 and 6160 only where missing, so operator edits survive. 1110 and 1115 join REQUIRED_ACCOUNT_CODES, so /health warns per company if they are missing or inactive.

Till-clearing split: sweepTillClearing(tenantId) runs at boot, right after ensureChartOfAccounts, then daily.
- It computes X, the net of the company's 1110 lines that are neither 'receivable.*' entries nor ON ACCOUNT memos.
- When X ≠ 0 it posts one balanced entry 'ledger.till_clearing_split:<tenantId>:<n>', dated now, moving X to 1115. This runs under a per-company advisory lock, and n is the next sequence number.
- It is safe to re-run: after one sweep X = 0, so later runs post nothing. Post-deploy reversals of legacy 1110 entries, such as a pre-deploy Raast 'customer owes' write-off later reversed, are picked up by the next daily run.
- A refusal (for example a locked current period) is flagged posting_failed with sourceType 'ledger.till_clearing_split', and the REPOSTERS entry retries it.
- Historical journal lines are never edited. Lookups that find legacy REFUND DUE credits read both 1110 and 1115.

Rollback: the API image before this release ignores the new tables and columns, and its till-clearing lines would go back to 1110 (the next sweep after re-deploy moves them). On-account Payment rows written before a rollback would be booked to 1030 by the old summariseShiftSales fallback. So before rolling back, switch off on-account at the tills: suspend every client.

The migration also sorts after the other Wave B migrations when the orchestrator merges the schema into one file.
assumptions: TAX RATE: on-account bills are taxed at the CASH rate (15%, Concept.taxRateCash). The reduced 8% applies to card/digital payment at the point of sale, and an on-account bill is paid later by cheque or transfer. lib/pricing: tenderOf('on_account') = 'cash'. Hasnain may change this to the card rate with one line

CREDIT CONTROL: finance (admin/owner/management/finance) creates and edits clients. A NEW client and every credit-limit INCREASE wait for the CEO in the approvals inbox; a CEO-made change applies directly. Decreases and suspensions apply at once. Only the CEO can reactivate a suspended client

BLOCK RULE at the till: refused when the client is not active, the brand is not on its list, open exposure (unbilled + open statements/invoices) + this bill > credit limit, or any statement or invoice of the client is unpaid more than 7 days (per-client grace) past its due date. There is no manager override at the till: finance raises the limit or grace, or the client pays
TERMS: statement due date = issue date + 30 days (per client, 1-180)

STATEMENTS: finance issues them (bulk button) for the calendar month (PKT). A statement is a ReceivableInvoice kind 'statement' with no ledger entry and is never a second tax invoice (H14 'supply'). Corporate clients pay per statement; payments are recorded per statement, not auto-allocated across statements

SCOPE OF USE: on account settles the WHOLE bill in one go: no split with cash/card/Raast, no tip on the account, not offline. It is allowed only where the bill completes at payment (till sales and dine-in bills settled at the till), not on delivery or pickup orders

QR CARD: an opaque random code, hash-only storage, shown ONCE at issue/rotate and printed then. Reprinting means rotating (the old card stops working). A client may have several named cards (for example per authorised person), each revocable alone. A per-bill reference (PO or name) is optional unless the client requires it, and the printed bill carries a signature line
Clients are per company. A client that buys from two companies gets two accounts and two cards

LEDGER SPLIT: 1110 becomes invoiced customer balances only, and a new 1115 Till Clearing takes all till clearing (as the AR review recommended). The legacy balance is moved by a self-healing sweep journal. A Raast 'customer owes' write-off now goes to 1115

BAD DEBT (H15 default 'direct'): Dr 6160 for the full balance including sales tax (no sales-tax bad-debt relief) / Cr 1110. It may be partial. Finance requests with reason + 1-5 evidence files (photo or PDF, stored in the DB); the CEO approves each one, and the requester can never approve their own request. Approval suspends the client. Recovery reinstates and records the payment. There is no general provision

RAAST VOID (CEO only): finance may request, and only the CEO voids. It is limited to a provisional receipt on a cancelled/rejected order whose drawers are all closed with nothing failed and nothing ever booked. There is no ledger entry; the bank reference stays used, and finance books the statement credit and any refund with the bank-line adjustment
Refunding an on-account bill goes back to the client's account (Cr 1110) by default, with today's refund caps and manager PIN rules

The tablet has no till (no payment screens), so card scanning is built into the admin POS only: a keyboard-wedge USB/Bluetooth scanner, the camera via BarcodeDetector where the browser supports it (not desktop Windows Chrome), and a typed code

FISCAL POS: an on-account bill files with buyer = the client (legal name, NTN, STRN) and payment mode cash (FBR PaymentMode 2, SRB 'Cash'), to be confirmed with the POS vendor like Raast's mode 3. The vendor contract already says to accept unknown tender methods
Chasing: daily overdue flags, a 'send reminder' email (one per client per day) and statement emails through the company SMTP. No automatic dunning letters or interest on late payment
No new module id: on-account clients and write-offs sit inside the existing 'accounting' module, and the Raast void inside 'reconciliation'
risks: The 1110 → 1115 swap touches the most delicate till money code: the shift close, the R5 cancelled-ticket unwind and hand-back, saleBookingOf, the Raast saleBookedTx and the card failure after close. A miss leaves the cancelled-ticket books one-sided. About 48 existing assertions in 12 test files must move to 1115. Mitigation: legacy lookups read both codes, the sweep is self-healing and the tie-out report shows any drift. The orchestrator reviews agent A's diffs personally

summariseShiftSales today books any unknown paid method as card (1030). If the shiftPosting change does not land in the same release as the on-account route, on-account sales hit 1030. Ship the shared ledger edits and the till route together, and never roll back the API with live on-account clients (suspend them first)

The shared files are also edited by other Wave B areas: orderPosting.ts and shiftPosting.ts (delivery/COD), pos/service.ts (delivery overrides), payload.ts and receipt.ts (delivery fee carries tax), reports/service.ts, approvals providers.ts (the cash area replaces cash_voucher), trustops/cashVouchers.ts (evidence helper) and moneyBigint.test.ts. The orchestrator must merge them in sequence, not let agents edit them

ensureChartOfAccounts skips a code a company already has without checking its type. An operator-made '1115' or '6160' with another meaning would silently receive till clearing or bad debts. A /health check on type and name is needed (the gaps audit extra finding)

Fiscal vendor behaviour for tender 'on_account' and the buyer block is untested with the real POS. The contract says accept unknown methods, but the PaymentMode/modeOfPay mapping must be confirmed with the vendor before go-live

Card misuse: a copied code lets someone charge meals to the client. Mitigations: per-card labels, revocation with a flag on later use, optional required reference, a signature line, the monthly statement review by the client, and refunds through manager caps. There is no per-card daily cap

Deadlocks if a future path takes locks in another order. Documented order: order → client account → invoice (and lockRaastTx before the order lock for Raast). The write-off approval and statement void must take the account lock before the invoice lock

The sales-tax return reads output from the ledger. On-account sales are booked at the shift close like any till sale, so a bill on a drawer closed in the next month lands in that month (as for cash). The statement period uses chargedAt, so a statement month and a ledger month can differ by one drawer
The 15% cash-rate assumption for on-account is a CA/owner tax call. If it changes to the card rate, re-pricing of already-billed statements is not retroactive
Evidence files stored as bytes in Postgres (up to 5 × 3 MB per write-off) grow the DB. That is acceptable at the expected volume, and it is the same pattern as cash vouchers
BarcodeDetector is not available on every till browser. Without a hardware scanner the cashier types a 20-character code, which is slower but works
